high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of a social media post from an Instagram account named "nameisnani," which is verified as indicated by the blue checkmark next to the username. The post was made 7 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The main focus of the image is a person standing in front of a wall with large, three-dimensional letters spelling out "ORIGINAL COPY." The person is wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and a white shirt underneath. They have dark hair and a beard, and they are smiling at the camera.
